Punjab Police SI Preparation Strategy: My 613 to 713 Plan

Quick answer

Everything I did to go from 613 to 713 in the Punjab Police SI exam: daily routine, fitness, current affairs, revision, previous papers and mock tests.

In my first Sub Inspector exam, I scored 613 and the cut-off was 623. The next time, I scored 713. On this page I am putting everything I did during my preparation in one place. Each part has its own detailed blog.

AreaMy ruleFull blog
Daily hours8-10 hours a day, starting at 10 amHow Many Hours I Studied Daily
Study method1.5-hour shifts with fixed breaksThe 1.5-Hour Shift Method
Sleep8 hours every day, no compromiseWhy I Never Cut My 8 Hours
ExerciseGym or ground every eveningWhy I Never Skipped the Gym
DietLittle roti, light food, no sluggishnessWhat to Eat So You Don't Feel Sleepy
Current affairs1-1.5 years before the exam, only from monthly magazinesHow Many Months of Current Affairs; The Monthly Magazine Method
RevisionThe 1-7-30 ruleForget Everything in the Exam?
Previous papersOnly PYQs in the last 3 months, +100 marksFrom 613 to 713
Mock testsAt least 100, in exam conditionsWhy Mock Tests Matter Most
Negative peopleMeet less, fewer functionsHow to Deal with Relatives
MindsetDiscipline, consistency, no fear of failureDiscipline and Consistency; Failed a Government Exam?
With a job2 hours morning + 2 hours nightHow to Study While Working a Job

If you remember only 3 things

  1. Always solve previous year papers. They added 100 marks for me.
  2. Revision and mock tests matter as much as reading.
  3. Study every day, for months. This is a 6-month to 1-year process.
Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

How should I prepare for Punjab Police SI?

Study 8-10 hours a day in 1.5-hour shifts, read current affairs from monthly magazines, revise with the 1-7-30 rule, solve previous year papers in the last 3 months and attempt at least 100 mock tests.

How long does Punjab Police SI preparation take?

Plan for 6 months to a year of daily, steady study. My score went from 613 in the first attempt to 713 in the next.
